description: This file defines various Orleans grain classes related to testing log-based grains with different storage and consistency providers, including custom storage interfaces and configurations.

classes.name: LogTestGrainSharedStateStorage
classes.description: A grain class configured with Azure storage and log consistency provider for shared state storage.

classes.name: LogTestGrainSharedLogStorage
classes.description: A grain class configured with Azure storage and log consistency provider for shared log storage.

classes.name: LogTestGrainDefaultStorage
classes.description: A grain class using the default storage provider.

classes.name: LogTestGrainMemoryStorage
classes.description: A grain class configured with MemoryStore for in-memory storage.

classes.name: LogTestGrainCustomStorage
classes.description: A grain class implementing a custom storage interface with 'CustomStorage' provider.

classes.name: LogTestGrainCustomStoragePrimaryCluster
classes.description: A grain class with custom storage configured for primary cluster access only, using in-memory state and versioning.

methods.name: GetStorageGrain
methods.description: Retrieves the primary grain used for storage operations in LogTestGrainCustomStorage.

methods.name: ApplyUpdatesToStorage
methods.description: Applies a list of updates to the storage, with expected version checking.

methods.name: ReadStateFromStorage
methods.description: Reads the current state from storage, returning the latest version and state object.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Simulates asynchronous activation to test for deadlocks during grain activation.

methods.name: TransitionState
methods.description: Transitions the grain state based on a given update; presumed to be defined elsewhere.
